_note: Animated clips generated by `npm run clips`. `from`/`to` are images in the character folder (art/private/, or whatever WIFEY_ART points at). Loops start and end on the same frame so they repeat seamlessly; one-shots start and end on idle so she flows back into standing. Every prompt gets the shared camera/background rules appended by the script.

idle.prompt: She stands relaxed in place, breathing gently, shifting her weight slightly from one foot to the other, blinking naturally, with a soft warm smile. Subtle, natural movement only.

run-take.note: Not played directly: scripts/split-run.mjs cuts it into run-start, run (the loop) and run-stop.
run-take.prompt: She stands facing the viewer for a brief moment, then turns to her left so she is seen exactly side-on, facing the right edge of the frame, and breaks into a real energetic run in place as if on a treadmill: knees lift high, elbows bent with arms pumping, both feet leave the ground on every stride, slight forward lean, hair bouncing behind her. She keeps running on exactly the same spot for several seconds without moving across the frame. Then she slows to a stop, turns back to face the viewer and stands relaxed, exactly as at the start.

wave.prompt: She smiles brightly and waves hello at the viewer with one hand for a couple of seconds, then lowers her hand and goes back to standing relaxed.

talk.prompt: She talks warmly to the viewer with subtle, understated movement: gentle natural lip movement as if chatting, small nods, a soft smile, hands relaxed at her sides with at most one small gesture at waist height. No big arm movements. In the last second she finishes speaking and settles back to standing relaxed and still, exactly as at the start.

happy.prompt: She is delighted and proud: a big warm closed-lip smile with bright, crinkled happy eyes, she raises both fists in a small cheerful celebration and gives a little bounce, then lowers her arms and settles back to standing relaxed. Her lips stay together in a smile the whole time; her mouth never opens wide.

love.prompt: She blushes, smiles shyly and blows a kiss to the viewer, then goes back to standing relaxed.

point.prompt: With a sassy grin she points playfully at the viewer and wags her finger, then goes back to standing relaxed.

water.prompt: Holding the water bottle out toward the viewer, she gives it a small encouraging shake so the water sloshes inside, raises her eyebrows with a playful 'drink up' smile and a little nod, her other hand staying on her hip. She keeps holding the bottle out the whole time and ends exactly as she started.

meal.prompt: Holding the steel plate of food in both hands, she presents it toward the viewer with a warm caring smile, gently nods and tilts her head as if saying 'come, eat', lifting the plate slightly toward the viewer and back. The food stays neatly on the plate the whole time and she ends exactly as she started.

pout.prompt: She sulks with her arms crossed and cheeks puffed, glancing sideways, huffing and shifting her weight.

angry.prompt: Hands on hips, she frowns and taps her foot impatiently, shaking her head in exaggerated, playful annoyance.

sleepy.prompt: She yawns, rubs one eye and sways sleepily, her eyelids heavy.

thinking.prompt: Finger on her chin, she looks up thoughtfully and tilts her head from side to side as if deciding something.
